::: {#exm-first-rest}
#### Taking a list apart

Let `L` be the list `'(7 2 9)` (@def-list), which @sol-cons-list builds as `(cons 7 (cons 2 (cons 9 empty)))`.
Then `first` and `rest` take it apart:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(define L (cons 7 (cons 2 (cons 9 empty))))
(first L)
(rest L)
(first (rest L))
(rest (rest (rest L)))
```

The last value, `'()`, is how Racket prints `empty`.
`(first empty)` raises an error,
since the empty list is not built by `cons` and has no first element:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
#| error: true
(first empty)
```

:::
